title: Expanded item catalogue
stage: Design proposal — not implemented or playtest-balanced
rules: This is an expansion proposal, not implemented game content. Existing identifies a retained ability; Reworked identifies a proposed change to an existing ability. All prices shown are proposed base coin prices and need playtesting.

Bookmarks occupy five held slots and apply in visible scoring order. Markers own board positions for the Book: one Marker per square, given-covered squares are inactive, and each owned type gains one square per completed Level, up to nine. Buffs occupy two inventory slots and are consumed on use.

For NEW score rewards, an eligible placement is correct, non-Clue, not zeroed by a Boss, and made before the Puzzle is won. A qualifying Clear is a non-Clue, nonzero-scoring row, column, or box completed by that placement. An eligible Turn contains at least one eligible placement. New reward triggers do not farm Keep Filling. Existing Onyx explicitly restores Clue placement points only, never Clue Clear points.

Placement base points are 10 times the digit; each row, column, or box Clear has base 45. Flat placement bonuses apply before that event's multipliers. Direct score rewards bypass Turn Mult. Puzzle Mult and held Bookmark Mult are separate; item rules specify their scope.

All draw, return and exchange effects move existing numbers between Hand and Pool. The Sudoku solution, givens and number-conservation rule remain unchanged. A draw cannot exceed available Pool supply. Chance uses the seeded game stream.

Any choice with no legal target is unavailable and does not consume a Buff or charge an extra cost. Existing Boss restrictions still apply unless an item explicitly names an exception. Item-specific limits override general defaults.

The current shop rolls prices by category and rarity. This proposal uses item-specific base prices: Bookmarks 4–15, Markers 5–16, Buffs 3–10. Equal prices are intentional. Rarity describes offer frequency, not an automatic power ranking.

Marker identity uses glyph plus color, not color alone. Keep the board's resting glyph small; hold a square for its rule and retain the existing question-mark reference. Full recessed tiles on these sheets are shop/inspection artwork.

items.name: Morning Edition
items.currentEffect: +100 points at the end of each Turn
items.effect: At the end of each eligible Turn, add 100 direct points after banking. This bonus is not multiplied.
items.shortEffect: +100 direct points after each scoring Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible Turn bank
items.limit: Once per scheduled Turn; no Keep Filling or empty-Turn payout.
items.distinctHook: Reliable reward for spreading placements over multiple Turns.
items.icon: Newspaper with a small rising sun
items.implementationNotes: Existing .turnEnd directScore hook; add an eligible-placement flag for the Turn. The eligibility guard is an explicit change from the current unconditional payout.

items.name: Evening Edition
items.currentEffect: +300 points at the end of Turn 10
items.effect: When you bank Turn 10 with at least one eligible placement, add 300 direct points after banking. Extra Turns do not repeat the award.
items.shortEffect: +300 direct points on a scoring Turn 10.
items.trigger: Turn 10 bank
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; requires a real scoring placement on Turn 10.
items.distinctHook: Fixed late-Puzzle payoff rather than a repeated Turn payout.
items.icon: Newspaper with a small crescent
items.implementationNotes: Current Actions.endTurn deliberately dispatches .puzzleEnd on Turn 10; preserve that timing, adding eligibility. This does not move the award to puzzle completion or the final extended Turn.

items.name: Local Gossip
items.currentEffect: Every correct placement scores +30 flat
items.effect: Each correct placement gains 30 flat points before local multipliers and normal score-zeroing rules. Onyx may still restore scoring on its Clue placement.
items.shortEffect: +30 flat points per correct placement.
items.trigger: Correct placement
items.limit: Once per newly filled square; normal Clue and Boss score-zeroing still applies.
items.distinctHook: Reliable placement-volume build.
items.icon: Two overlapping speech bubbles
items.implementationNotes: Existing .place flat hook; preserve current Onyx-restored Clue interactions and final score zeroing. Do not silently introduce a new non-Clue gate.

items.name: Sports Section
items.currentEffect: Line Clears gain +25
items.effect: Each completed row, column, or box gains 25 flat Line Clear points before local multipliers. Clue-created clears still score zero.
items.shortEffect: +25 points per row, column or box clear.
items.trigger: Line Clear
items.limit: Once per newly completed unit; simultaneous units each qualify; normal score-zeroing applies.
items.distinctHook: Flat boost to unit completion rather than placements.
items.icon: Running figure crossing a finish line
items.implementationNotes: Existing .lineClear flat hook; retain current per-unit events and normal Clue/Boss score zeroing.

items.name: Society Pages
items.currentEffect: Full Clear gains +500
items.effect: A Full Clear gains 500 flat Full Clear points before local multipliers. A Clue-created Full Clear still scores zero.
items.shortEffect: +500 points on a Full Clear.
items.trigger: Full Clear
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; normal score-zeroing and frozen Keep Filling score remain.
items.distinctHook: Large board-completion payoff.
items.icon: Crown above a tiny complete grid
items.implementationNotes: Existing .fullClear flat hook; preserve current score resolution without adding a new event guard.

items.name: Op-Ed Column
items.currentEffect: +1 mult
items.effect: Add 1 to Turn Mult at this Bookmark's locked slot when the Turn banks.
items.shortEffect: +1 Turn Mult.
items.trigger: Turn bank
items.limit: One held-Mult operation per Turn; no added points if the bank is zero.
items.distinctHook: Simple additive Mult that can be ordered before multipliers.
items.icon: Single quotation mark over one text line
items.implementationNotes: Keep .anyScore as a pure held-Mult read, evaluated in the locked visible order.

items.name: Editorial Board
items.currentEffect: +2 mult
items.effect: If this Turn included eligible placements in at least three different 3×3 boxes, add 3 to its Turn Mult at this Bookmark's locked slot.
items.shortEffect: +3 Mult after scoring placements in 3 different boxes this Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible Turn bank after three-box coverage
items.limit: Once per Turn; unique boxes only.
items.distinctHook: Rewards broad board coverage instead of being Op-Ed with a larger number.
items.icon: Three compact quotation marks across a row
items.implementationNotes: Replace the unconditional +2. Store a nine-bit eligible-box mask per Turn; the Mult preview reads it without rerunning events.

items.name: Front Page Splash
items.currentEffect: +1 mult per Bookmark owned, including itself
items.effect: Add 1 Turn Mult for each Bookmark in the locked loadout, including this one, at this Bookmark's slot.
items.shortEffect: +1 Mult per owned Bookmark, including itself.
items.trigger: Turn bank
items.limit: Count locked loadout once; normal capacity five.
items.distinctHook: Makes filling the limited Bookmark loadout valuable.
items.icon: Megaphone over a newspaper front page
items.implementationNotes: Existing bookmarkCount-based .anyScore; use the existing locked snapshot and disabled-item policy.

items.name: Letters to the Editor
items.currentEffect: +3 mult, Boss Puzzles only
items.effect: In a Boss Puzzle, a Turn following a Turn where you paid a wrong-placement penalty gains +3 Turn Mult at this Bookmark's slot, provided the current Turn is eligible.
items.shortEffect: +3 Mult on a Boss Turn after a penalized Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible Boss Turn bank after a previous penalized Turn
items.limit: Once per Turn; fully waived penalties do not qualify; no stacking per mistake.
items.distinctHook: Recovery route that pays after absorbing a real loss.
items.icon: Envelope containing a quotation mark
items.implementationNotes: Replace unconditional Boss +3 with a previous-Turn paid-penalty flag. Record actual penalty after waivers, not wrong-click count; reset at puzzle start.

items.name: Rolling Presses
items.currentEffect: Starts at x1, gains +x0.5 per Line Clear this Puzzle. Resets each Puzzle
items.effect: Start each Puzzle at ×1. Each Line Clear adds ×0.5 to this Bookmark's held multiplier; apply the resulting factor at its locked slot when a Turn banks.
items.shortEffect: Held ×Mult grows by ×0.5 per Line Clear; resets each Puzzle.
items.trigger: Line Clear growth; Turn bank application
items.limit: Each unit can grow it once; reset at Puzzle start.
items.distinctHook: Within-Puzzle clear-driven multiplicative growth.
items.icon: Two printing gears with one curved motion line
items.implementationNotes: Existing .lineClear puzzle counter and pure .anyScore factor. Preserve current growth even on a Clue-created/zeroed clear; Keep Filling still cannot add score. Growth earned this Turn is included before banking.

items.name: Syndication
items.currentEffect: Starts at x1, permanently gains +x0.25 every Puzzle you win. Resets only at a new Book
items.effect: Start the Book at ×1. Each Puzzle win adds ×0.25 for later Puzzles; apply the stored factor at this Bookmark's locked slot.
items.shortEffect: Held ×Mult grows by ×0.25 per Puzzle won.
items.trigger: Puzzle win; subsequent Turn banks
items.limit: One increase per Puzzle win; skipped Puzzles do not count; reset with Book.
items.distinctHook: Long-run investment rather than immediate Puzzle power.
items.icon: Two linked newspaper copies
items.implementationNotes: Keep the existing win-payout growth path and run state. Do not award growth twice after Keep Filling or replayed payout.

items.name: Stop the Presses
items.currentEffect: x3 mult, always
items.effect: Multiply Turn Mult by 3 at this Bookmark's locked slot only when the Turn contains one or two eligible placements. A third eligible placement removes this Turn's bonus.
items.shortEffect: ×3 Turn Mult if you score only 1–2 placements this Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible Turn bank
items.limit: One held factor per Turn; count placements, not their clears.
items.distinctHook: High-Mult low-volume tempo tradeoff.
items.icon: Printing gears interrupted by a horizontal stop bar
items.implementationNotes: Replace always-on ×3 with a Turn eligible-placement counter. Clues and zeroed placements neither qualify nor increment the count; preview must show losing the factor after a third scoring placement.

items.name: The Sunday Supplement
items.currentEffect: x2 mult; x3 on Boss Puzzles
items.effect: Multiply Turn Mult by 2 at this Bookmark's locked slot; use ×3 during a Boss Puzzle instead.
items.shortEffect: ×2 Turn Mult; ×3 in Boss Puzzles.
items.trigger: Turn bank
items.limit: Once per Turn in locked slot order.
items.distinctHook: Reliable multiplier with a chapter-climax premium.
items.icon: Open supplement with a small Sunday sun
items.implementationNotes: Existing pure .anyScore difficulty branch. Unlike reworked Stop the Presses, there is no placement-volume restriction.

items.name: Extra! Extra!
items.currentEffect: Line Clears and Full Clears score x3
items.effect: Multiply the local points of each Line Clear and Full Clear by 3 before they join the Turn bank. Normal Clue and Boss score-zeroing still applies.
items.shortEffect: ×3 Line Clear and Full Clear points.
items.trigger: Line Clear or Full Clear
items.limit: Each newly completed unit/full board once; does not multiply adjacent placement points.
items.distinctHook: Event-local clear multiplier rather than a held Turn-Mult modifier.
items.icon: Megaphone with two short emphasis rays
items.implementationNotes: Preserve eventMultX on clear events; never convert this into global Turn Mult.

items.name: Finance Pages
items.currentEffect: +1 coin per Line Clear
items.effect: Gain 1 coin for each row, column, or box clear, including clears made by Clues or during Keep Filling.
items.shortEffect: +1 coin per Line Clear, including Clue and Keep Filling clears.
items.trigger: Line Clear
items.limit: Once per newly completed unit; score-zeroing does not cancel its coin reward.
items.distinctHook: Liquid income tied to finishing units.
items.icon: Rising chart ending in a small coin
items.implementationNotes: Preserve current unconditional .lineClear coins hook: Actions applies side effects even when Clue/Boss points are zero or score is frozen. The new-item anti-farming guard must not silently change this legacy ability.

items.name: Paper Route
items.currentEffect: +2 coins on every Puzzle win payout
items.effect: Gain 2 extra coins in each Puzzle-win payout.
items.shortEffect: +2 coins per Puzzle won.
items.trigger: Puzzle-win payout
items.limit: Once per won Puzzle; no skipped-Puzzle or repeated payout.
items.distinctHook: Steady economy independent of clear count.
items.icon: Bicycle carrying one folded newspaper
items.implementationNotes: Existing Paper Route payout component; preserve payout idempotence.

items.name: Market Wrap
items.currentEffect: Interest cap raised from 10 to 15
items.effect: Raise the base cap on each Puzzle-win interest payout from 10 to 15 coins while owned. Other Book, Clipping, or subscription cap modifiers still apply.
items.shortEffect: Base interest payout cap rises from 10 to 15 coins.
items.trigger: Puzzle-win interest payout calculation
items.limit: Changes the payout cap, not the coin balance that earns interest; stronger base-cap replacements still win.
items.distinctHook: Rewards saving money rather than immediate spending.
items.icon: Rising chart beneath a horizontal cap line
items.implementationNotes: Verified RunState.interestCap: choose Market Wrap base 15 (otherwise 10), Annual Rate replaces that base with 20, then add Book and Clipping deltas. Interest is floor(coins/10), capped by that result; preserve this exact order.

items.name: Auction Notices
items.currentEffect: First reroll in each Shop is free
items.effect: The first paid reroll you request in each Shop costs 0 coins.
items.shortEffect: First reroll in each Shop is free.
items.trigger: First reroll request in a Shop visit
items.limit: Once per visit; entering the same visit again does not refresh it.
items.distinctHook: Shop access and stock variety.
items.icon: Auction hammer beside a small circular arrow
items.implementationNotes: Existing Auction Notices price query; retain canonical visit ID and advance reroll count normally.

items.name: Help Wanted
items.currentEffect: Hand size +1
items.effect: Increase the Hand refill target by 1 while this Bookmark is owned; other boss and item adjustments still apply.
items.shortEffect: +1 Hand refill size.
items.trigger: Puzzle setup and Turn refill
items.limit: Standing +1; unplaced cards already carry over normally.
items.distinctHook: Broad card availability rather than extra immediate draws.
items.icon: Person silhouette with a small plus
items.implementationNotes: Use existing effectiveHandSize. Do not describe baseline Hand carryover as part of this effect.

items.name: Weather Forecast
items.currentEffect: Toss allowance +2
items.effect: Add 2 to each Puzzle's Toss allowance while this Bookmark is owned.
items.shortEffect: +2 Tosses per Puzzle.
items.trigger: Puzzle setup
items.limit: One +2 allowance grant per Puzzle; does not refill on save/reopen.
items.distinctHook: More control over unsuitable Hand cards.
items.icon: Cloud with two small wind strokes
items.implementationNotes: Existing effectiveTossAllowance query; preserve boss adjustments and normal Toss cost.

items.name: Puzzle Corner
items.currentEffect: +1 Clue every Puzzle
items.effect: Add 1 Clue at the start of each Puzzle while this Bookmark is owned. Boss rules that disable Clues still apply.
items.shortEffect: +1 Clue per Puzzle.
items.trigger: Puzzle setup
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; Clue placements retain their zero-score rule.
items.distinctHook: Reliable limited-information resource.
items.icon: Puzzle piece containing a small question mark
items.implementationNotes: Existing effectiveClues query. Never restore Clue scoring or bypass a Clue-disabled Boss.

items.name: Late City Final
items.currentEffect: +1 Turn every Puzzle
items.effect: Add 1 scheduled Turn to each Puzzle while this Bookmark is owned.
items.shortEffect: +1 Turn per Puzzle.
items.trigger: Puzzle setup
items.limit: One standing Turn extension; does not move Evening Edition from Turn 10.
items.distinctHook: More time to spend the finite Pool and satisfy the target.
items.icon: Moon above a small clock dial
items.implementationNotes: Existing effectiveTurns query; preserve normal loss, refill, and automatic Turn-end rules.

items.name: Crossword Daily
items.currentEffect: After each Line Clear, draw 1 number from the Pool
items.effect: After each row, column, or box clear, draw 1 number from the Pool into the Hand, including Clue and Keep Filling clears.
items.shortEffect: Draw 1 Pool number per Line Clear, including Clue and Keep Filling clears.
items.trigger: Line Clear
items.limit: Once per newly completed unit; each draw requires an actual Pool card.
items.distinctHook: Clear-driven Hand refill that can exceed the usual refill target.
items.icon: Crossword grid with one outward number tile
items.implementationNotes: Preserve the current unconditional .lineClear draws hook and finite Pool conservation. Normal Hand carryover is unchanged; zero-score clears still draw.

items.name: Margin Notes
items.effect: Eligible placements on the board's outermost row or column gain 50 flat points before local multipliers.
items.shortEffect: +50 placement points on the board's outer edge.
items.trigger: Eligible placement on perimeter
items.limit: One bonus per placement, including corners; not once per touching edge.
items.distinctHook: A board-position build that rewards the perimeter.
items.icon: L-shaped page margin with a single dot
items.implementationNotes: New .place square-coordinate predicate; no new solution information. Append one flat contribution even at a corner.

items.name: Neighbourhood News
items.effect: An eligible placement touching at least two previously player-filled squares orthogonally gains 45 flat points before local multipliers. Givens and Clue-filled squares do not count as neighbours.
items.shortEffect: +45 points beside at least 2 player-filled orthogonal neighbours.
items.trigger: Eligible placement with own orthogonal neighbours
items.limit: Once per placement; inspect the board before filling the square.
items.distinctHook: Rewards building connected clusters rather than fixed regions.
items.icon: Three linked square windows
items.implementationNotes: Extend context with prior orthogonal occupancy and fill provenance. Diagonals, Givens, and Clue provenance are excluded.

items.name: Serial Story
items.effect: The third eligible placement in a consecutive ascending run such as 2→3→4 gains 120 flat points before local multipliers. A wrong, Clue, zeroed, or nonconsecutive placement breaks the run.
items.shortEffect: +120 points on a 3-number ascending run, once per Turn.
items.trigger: Third placement in ascending-by-one run
items.limit: Once per Turn; no 9→1 wrap; reset at Turn end.
items.distinctHook: Intentional placement order across different digits.
items.icon: Three numbered dots joined by a rising line
items.implementationNotes: Persist the last eligible digit and streak length per Turn. After payout consume the Turn trigger; unrelated clear events must not break the placement sequence.

items.name: Double Column
items.effect: If you place the same digit eligibly in two different boxes during a Turn, add 2 Turn Mult at this Bookmark's locked slot when that Turn banks.
items.shortEffect: +2 Mult after scoring the same digit in 2 boxes this Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible same-digit placements in distinct boxes; bank
items.limit: Once per Turn regardless of additional matched pairs.
items.distinctHook: Values repeated digits in the Hand without rewarding an invalid duplicate in one unit.
items.icon: Two thin columns joined by an equals sign
items.implementationNotes: Track digit-to-box masks for eligible placements during the Turn; pure bank predicate reads any mask with at least two boxes.

items.name: Carryover
items.effect: After an eligible Turn banks, add direct points equal to 10% of the previous Turn's ordinary bank, rounded down and capped at 300. Direct bonuses are excluded from the copied amount.
items.shortEffect: Carry 10% of the previous Turn's bank into this one; max 300.
items.trigger: Eligible Turn bank after an earlier Turn
items.limit: Once per Turn; Turn 1 has no prior bank; reset each Puzzle.
items.distinctHook: Links a strong Turn to the next without copying bonuses recursively.
items.icon: Two offset ledger boxes linked by a bent arrow
items.implementationNotes: Store the finalized ordinary bank before directScore contributions. Award this after current bank; snapshot prior bank even if zero; never feed Carryover into itself.

items.name: Number Index
items.effect: The first time you score all nine different digits in a Puzzle, this Bookmark permanently gains +2 held Turn Mult for the rest of the Book, including the current Turn.
items.shortEffect: +2 permanent Mult after scoring all 9 digits in a Puzzle.
items.trigger: Eligible placements complete a nine-digit set
items.limit: At most +2 per Puzzle and +10 per Book; each digit counted once per Puzzle.
items.distinctHook: A varied-digit collection goal with permanent additive growth.
items.icon: A circular index of small numbered tabs
items.implementationNotes: Add a Puzzle digit bitmask and a run growth counter capped at ten. Apply earned +Mult at this locked slot; persist activation once and exclude skipped Puzzles.

items.name: Early Deadline
items.effect: Win a Puzzle by the end of Turn 5 to gain 4 extra coins in its payout.
items.shortEffect: +4 coins for winning by Turn 5.
items.trigger: Scored Puzzle-win payout with winning Turn ≤5
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; no reward for skipping.
items.distinctHook: Trades optional later-board gains for an early economy payout.
items.icon: Clock hand pointing to a small finish pennant
items.implementationNotes: Record the actual winning bank's Turn before incrementing turnNumber. Payout must be idempotent and independent of later Keep Filling.

items.name: Duplicate Dispatch
items.effect: Once per Puzzle, at a Turn's start with at least three copies of one digit in your Hand, you may return all but one of those copies to the Pool and draw the same number of replacements.
items.shortEffect: Once per Puzzle, exchange a Hand clump of 3+ matching numbers.
items.trigger: Player accepts a qualifying Turn-start exchange
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; no exchange after that Turn's first action.
items.distinctHook: Repairs a duplicate-heavy Hand, unlike baseline carryover.
items.icon: Three overlapping equal-number tiles with one curved exit arrow
items.implementationNotes: New optional start-Turn action and used flag. Return cards before drawing with the seeded Pool stream; replacements may repeat, conserve Pool+Hand counts, and cancel consumes nothing.

items.name: Overflow Column
items.effect: Before each eligible placement, count how many cards the Hand holds above its normal refill target. Add 25 flat placement points per excess card, capped at 100.
items.shortEffect: +25 points per card above your refill size; max +100 per placement.
items.trigger: Eligible placement from an overfilled Hand
items.limit: Count before removing the placed card; capped at four excess cards.
items.distinctHook: Converts draw-heavy builds into score while the surplus lasts.
items.icon: A short column of tiles spilling above its top line
items.implementationNotes: Expose pre-placement Hand count and current effectiveHandSize in context. The target already includes Help Wanted and boss adjustments; do not treat ordinary carried cards as overflow unless count exceeds it.

items.name: Paper Salvage
items.effect: The first Toss you make in a Puzzle immediately draws 1 replacement number from the Pool. The Toss still spends its normal allowance.
items.shortEffect: Your first Toss each Puzzle draws a replacement immediately.
items.trigger: First successful Toss while playing
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; requires a remaining Pool card.
items.distinctHook: One controlled tempo-saving discard.
items.icon: Folded scrap entering a small return loop
items.implementationNotes: New Toss hook after normal card return and allowance spend; draw from seeded Pool without altering automatic final-card Turn-end policy. Resolve replacement before checking whether Hand is empty.

items.name: Forthcoming Edition
items.effect: Show the next two numbers that the current Pool would draw. Refresh the preview whenever the Pool or its draw state changes.
items.shortEffect: Preview the next 2 Pool draws.
items.trigger: Pool/draw-state observation
items.limit: Information only; never consumes or changes a draw or reveals a solution.
items.distinctHook: Planning utility based on upcoming supply.
items.icon: Folded newspaper with two small numbered peek tabs
items.implementationNotes: New read-only forecast view using a cloned Pool and RNG state. Preview must match actual future draws, update after exchanges, and never advance the live RNG.

items.name: Carbon Paper
items.effect: Once per Turn, an eligible marked placement that adds marker-only extra placement points stores that extra amount, capped at 180. Add it as flat points to your next eligible unmarked placement that Turn, then clear it.
items.shortEffect: Carry up to 180 marker bonus points to the next unmarked square.
items.trigger: Eligible marked placement arms; next eligible unmarked placement consumes
items.limit: One positive-bonus transfer per Turn; unused bonus expires; zero or negative marker bonuses do not arm it.
items.distinctHook: Spreads a positional score benefit to a different unmarked square.
items.icon: Two paper layers with a small dot printed through both
items.implementationNotes: New receipt-based marker-only delta excluding all Bookmarks, Buffs, global Mult, coins, draws, and copied effects. Define delta against the same placement without its marker; cap at 180 after marker-local factors; do not copy Clue-restoring Onyx scoring.

items.name: Pocket Insert
items.effect: Increase your Buff inventory capacity from 2 to 3 while this Bookmark is owned.
items.shortEffect: +1 Buff inventory slot.
items.trigger: Inventory capacity query
items.limit: One added slot; never creates a Buff.
items.distinctHook: Exchanges one passive slot for additional consumable storage.
items.icon: Small paper pocket holding one dark tab
items.implementationNotes: New dynamic Buff-capacity query and inventory layout. Before selling/removing this with three Buffs held, require a reversible inventory choice; never silently delete an item.

items.name: Bulk Notice
items.effect: Reduce the first Buff you buy in each Shop by 1 coin, to a minimum price of 1.
items.shortEffect: First Buff bought in each Shop costs 1 coin less.
items.trigger: First completed Buff purchase of a visit
items.limit: Once per visit; inspecting/cancelling does not spend the discount.
items.distinctHook: Encourages regular consumable purchases.
items.icon: Two small receipts beneath a single minus notch
items.implementationNotes: New per-visit Buff-purchase flag and final-price calculation. Display adjusted price before confirmation; free rewards do not consume it.

items.name: Buyback Column
items.effect: Once per Shop, sell one other Bookmark you already owned on entry for its actual purchase price instead of the normal resale value.
items.shortEffect: Once per Shop, fully refund one previously owned Bookmark.
items.trigger: Eligible Bookmark sale in Shop
items.limit: Once per visit; excludes this item and items bought in that visit; refund cannot exceed actual paid price.
items.distinctHook: Supports changing builds without creating resale profit.
items.icon: Bookmark tab circling back to a coin
items.implementationNotes: New sale quote and Shop-entry owned-instance snapshot. Price paid includes prior discounts; consume only on confirmed sale; no same-visit buy/sell arbitrage.

items.name: Window Shopping
items.effect: Leave a Shop without buying any item or requesting any reroll to gain 3 coins. Selling owned items does not disqualify you.
items.shortEffect: +3 coins when you leave a Shop without buying or rerolling.
items.trigger: Shop Continue/exit
items.limit: Once per canonical visit; free rerolls count as rerolls.
items.distinctHook: A deliberate save-money route rather than purchase discounts.
items.icon: Shop window outline with a closed coin purse
items.implementationNotes: Track visit purchases and reroll requests, including free rerolls; pay once on committed exit, never on entering/exiting a detail sheet.

items.name: Advance Payment
items.effect: Before the first action of each Puzzle, you may pay 3 coins to activate ×2.5 Turn Mult at this Bookmark's locked slot for that Puzzle.
items.shortEffect: Pay 3 coins at Puzzle start for ×2.5 Mult that Puzzle.
items.trigger: Optional pre-Puzzle payment; eligible Turn banks
items.limit: One payment per Puzzle; no credit or refund; skipped Puzzles have no offer.
items.distinctHook: Converts spare money into a chosen short-term scoring boost.
items.icon: Coin partially slid under a multiplier stamp
items.implementationNotes: New optional start action, affordability check, and Puzzle activation flag; the fixed ×2.5 factor is read at bank in both ordinary and Boss Puzzles. Save/reopen cannot repeat payment or reopen a declined choice after play begins. This costs recurring coins to exceed Sunday Supplement in ordinary Puzzles, while Sunday remains stronger in Boss Puzzles.

items.name: Type Case
items.effect: At each Turn's start, choose one digit currently in your Hand to hold in reserve. Your first three eligible placements of other digits gain 50 flat points each; placing the chosen digit ends the bonus for that Turn.
items.shortEffect: Hold a chosen digit: the first 3 other placements gain +50 points.
items.trigger: Turn-start digit choice; eligible placements until chosen digit placed
items.limit: Up to three bonuses per Turn; any placement of chosen digit ends it; no choice after first action.
items.distinctHook: Makes keeping a particular Hand digit an intentional scoring tradeoff.
items.icon: One fixed type block beside three loose type blocks
items.implementationNotes: New one-tap optional digit choice; no physical new reserve slot and no change to Hand carryover. A Clue/zeroed chosen-digit placement ends the arm but cannot earn a bonus; wrong chosen-digit attempt also ends it to prevent repeated probing.

items.name: Cross Reference
items.effect: When one eligible placement completes at least two of row, column, and box, schedule 2 extra Pool draws after the next ordinary Turn refill.
items.shortEffect: Clear 2 unit types at once: draw 2 extra numbers next Turn.
items.trigger: Eligible placement completing multiple unit types
items.limit: At most two triggers per Puzzle; one two-card packet per placement; Pool availability applies.
items.distinctHook: Sets up an overfull future Hand through intersecting completions.
items.icon: Crossing row and column with two outward tiles
items.implementationNotes: Use completed unit identities, not repeated .lineClear events. Queue draw packets until after the next actual playable-Turn refill; discard them if the Puzzle ends before another Turn.

items.name: Issue Tracker
items.effect: On an eligible box clear, gain 1 coin for each different Turn in which you scored a placement inside that box, capped at 3 coins.
items.shortEffect: A box clear pays up to 3 coins for working on it across Turns.
items.trigger: Eligible 3×3 box clear
items.limit: Each box once; maximum three coins per box; rows and columns do not pay.
items.distinctHook: Rewards staged progress over several Turns.
items.icon: A small box grid beside three calendar dots
items.implementationNotes: Track eligible Turn IDs per box; Givens and Clue placements add no participation. Check the box-completion event once, then consume its tracker.

items.name: Correction Ledger
items.effect: Record half of the first wrong-placement penalty you actually pay each Puzzle, rounded down and capped at 150. After three later eligible placements, refund that amount as direct score.
