This is an explicit optional design expansion, not existing behavior. Use contextual inspection near Hand; no permanent bonus bar. Never reveal the sequence or solution.

items.name: Bounty Marker
items.effect: After a qualifying placement here, a seeded random unmarked blank elsewhere in this box is selected. If you fill that target with an eligible correct placement before this Turn ends, that placement gains +120 Points. No eligible target means no contract.
items.shortEffect: Fill the nominated blank in this box this Turn for +120 Points.
items.trigger: Eligible correct placement on an owned square.
items.limit: 1 active target; 2 successful bounties per Puzzle. Target is never a Given, occupied, marked, or currently barred square.
items.distinctHook: Specific-square spatial contract, not a new Marker owner.
items.icon: scope
items.implementationNotes: Marker remains on its owned board coordinates for the Book; each completed Level grants one additional owned square, capped at 9. One Marker owner per square. Given-covered squares are inactive. NEW eligibility gate: natural, non-Clue correct placement whose placement event would earn positive points before this Marker; .playing only, never Keep Filling. No reward from a zeroed boss event. NEW HOOK required; store counters/contracts in saved Puzzle state and credit the source in score receipts. Any random choice uses a dedicated saved seeded stream; previews never advance it. NEW temporary target reference; source inspection can highlight it on demand, with no new persistent glyph or bonus bar. Sample only visible geometry/availability, never solution digits or Hand-solvability. Expire on Turn end, Clue fill, or target zero-score fill. No marker triggers propagate to neighbors.

items.name: Harvest Marker
items.effect: After a qualifying placement here, you may return every remaining unblocked Hand copy of that same digit, up to 3 cards, and draw the same number of random Pool cards of other digits. Offer only when enough other-digit cards exist. At most once per Puzzle.
items.shortEffect: Exchange up to 3 leftover copies of this digit for different digits.
items.trigger: Eligible correct placement on an owned square.
items.limit: 1 batch per Puzzle, maximum 3 cards; card count conserved; no partial transaction.
items.distinctHook: Placed-digit duplicate pruning in a conserved batch exchange.
items.icon: custom: three simple grain stalks
items.implementationNotes: Marker remains on its owned board coordinates for the Book; each completed Level grants one additional owned square, capped at 9. One Marker owner per square. Given-covered squares are inactive. NEW eligibility gate: natural, non-Clue correct placement whose placement event would earn positive points before this Marker; .playing only, never Keep Filling. No reward from a zeroed boss event. NEW HOOK required; store counters/contracts in saved Puzzle state and credit the source in score receipts. Any random choice uses a dedicated saved seeded stream; previews never advance it. NEW atomic batch exchange. All replacements exclude the triggering digit and are sampled from actual Pool counts using seeded RNG. Do not select barred Hand cards; does not spend Toss allowance or bypass play bans. Save choice/result together to prevent reroll abuse.

items.name: Peek
items.currentEffect: Gain 1 Clue: reveal a legal square for a number in your Hand. That placement scores 0 unless marked with Onyx
items.effect: Gain 1 Clue for the current Puzzle. Spending the Clue reveals a solution-correct destination for a number in your Hand; that revealed placement scores zero unless Onyx restores its placement points, and its Line Clears still score zero.
items.shortEffect: +1 Clue this Puzzle; a revealed placement scores 0 unless Onyx restores it.
items.trigger: Use during a playable Puzzle; later spend the gained Clue through the existing Clue action.
items.limit: One Clue per consumed copy; the gain may stack. Existing engine permits use during Keep Filling, but Paywall and Buffborger prohibit the applicable action.
items.distinctHook: Stores a Clue charge rather than immediately drawing, placing, or scoring a number.
items.icon: One ivory eye looking through a small square aperture; fine uniform line on a charcoal token with a gold top edge.
items.implementationNotes: Existing Buffs.peek and Actions.useBuff behavior; preserve actual Clue provenance, reveal guards, and Onyx exception. Price proposal remains 3. Do not portray this as a free scoring placement.

items.name: Redraw
items.currentEffect: Return your whole Hand to the Pool and immediately draw a fresh one. Does not spend Toss allowance
items.effect: Return every number in your Hand to the Pool, then draw up to your normal Hand refill target (effectiveHandSize) from that Pool. This spends no Toss allowance and can redraw numbers you just returned.
items.shortEffect: Return the whole Hand, then draw a fresh Hand without spending Tosses.
items.trigger: Immediate use during a playable Puzzle.
items.limit: One complete return-and-refill per consumed copy; draw stops when the Pool is empty. Existing engine also permits Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Resets the entire Hand with an immediate refill rather than selecting individual cards.
items.icon: Three small ivory card corners enclosed by one circular arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing Actions.redrawHand atomically returns all tokens before seeded Pool.draw. Hand size is a refill target, not an absolute cap. Preserve the potential to redraw the same digits and do not call Toss hooks.

items.name: Overtime
items.currentEffect: +2 Turns this Puzzle
items.effect: Increase the current Puzzle's maximum Turns by 2. Existing Hand, queued points, current Turn number, and the normal refill process are unchanged.
items.shortEffect: +2 Turns for this Puzzle.
items.trigger: Immediate use during a playable Puzzle.
items.limit: Two extra Turns per consumed copy; the existing engine permits repeated copies and Keep Filling use, but not use after terminal failure.
items.distinctHook: Adds time to solve and bank points without immediately refilling the Hand.
items.icon: An ivory clock with a small two-stroke extension at its rim; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing extraTurns hook; proposed price rises from 4 to 7 because two full Turns are a substantial scarce resource. Do not silently apply a new once-per-Puzzle cap or rewrite existing Keep Filling behavior.

items.name: Double Down
items.currentEffect: Your next non-Clue placement that earns Points scores x2
items.effect: Arm a doubler for the next non-Clue correct placement whose points are not zeroed; double that placement's points only. Clues, wrong placements, and zeroed placements do not spend the armed charge.
items.shortEffect: Your next eligible non-Clue placement scores twice.
items.trigger: Next eligible correct placement after use.
items.limit: One armed charge, expiring at Puzzle end; another copy cannot be consumed while it remains armed. Existing engine rejects use in Keep Filling.
items.distinctHook: A single placement-point multiplier, separate from Line Clear doubling and Turn Mult.
items.icon: Two matching ivory square outlines offset diagonally, linked by a small multiplication cross; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing doubleDown arm flag and scoring-ledger doubler; preserve the non-Clue and zeroed-event guards and the no-stacking use guard. Proposed price 5 replaces current 4.

items.name: Insurance
items.currentEffect: Your next wrong placement takes no penalty
items.effect: Cancel the next wrong-placement score penalty that would otherwise apply. The number still follows normal wrong-placement routing to the Pool, or to the Hand if Jade supplies that separate effect.
items.shortEffect: Cancel your next otherwise-unprotected wrong-placement penalty.
items.trigger: Next wrong placement with a penalty not already waived by another rule.
items.limit: One armed charge until Puzzle end; cannot arm a duplicate copy. Existing engine rejects use in Keep Filling and does not waste the charge on an already-waived penalty.
items.distinctHook: Penalty protection, without revealing correctness or returning the number by itself.
items.icon: An ivory shield surrounding a small minus sign; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Preserve Actions.resolveWrong resolution order: square protection, held protection, then Insurance. The accepted placement can still incur a boss coin fee; this Buff cancels the score penalty only.

items.name: Second Print
items.currentEffect: The next non-Clue Line Clear that earns Points scores twice
items.effect: Double the next non-Clue Line Clear whose points are not zeroed. If one placement completes several units, only the first eligible unit in the engine's existing resolution order consumes this charge.
items.shortEffect: Double the next eligible non-Clue Line Clear.
items.trigger: Next eligible row, column, or box Line Clear after use.
items.limit: One charge until Puzzle end; no duplicate arming and no Keep Filling use under the existing engine.
items.distinctHook: Doubles one actual Line Clear rather than placement points or every unit of a multi-clear.
items.icon: Two short parallel ivory completed-line strips, each containing three square cells; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing secondPrint flag; do not multiply all three units on a crossing completion. Preserve the rule that Clue Line Clears remain zero even on Onyx. Proposed price 5 replaces 4.

items.name: Lucky Dip
items.currentEffect: Draw 2 numbers from the Pool
items.effect: Immediately draw up to 2 random numbers from the Pool into your Hand. Draw fewer if the Pool has only one number left; do not consume the Buff if the Pool is empty.
items.shortEffect: Draw up to 2 numbers from the Pool.
items.trigger: Immediate use during a playable Puzzle.
items.limit: At most two conserved tokens per copy; can exceed the normal Hand-size refill target. Existing engine permits Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Immediate additional random numbers without returning any held number.
items.icon: Exactly two overlapping ivory mystery-number card outlines with tiny question marks; approved Lucky Dip motif, on charcoal with a gold top edge.
items.implementationNotes: Existing Pool.draw with run.streams.pool; retain empty-Pool guard and stop-at-empty semantics. Never fabricate two extra number tokens or introduce a hard Hand cap that deletes overflow.

items.name: Bird Seed
items.currentEffect: +1 coin per Line Clear for the rest of the Level
items.effect: Gain 1 additional coin for each actual Line Clear for the rest of the current Level. One placement completing several units pays once for each completed unit, according to the existing lineClear hook.
items.shortEffect: +1 coin per Line Clear for the rest of this Level.
items.trigger: Every subsequent actual Line Clear while the current Level matches its recorded activation Level.
items.limit: Cannot consume another Bird Seed while its Level-long effect is active. Existing behavior includes Clue and Keep Filling clears; a finite unit cannot be cleared repeatedly.
items.distinctHook: A consumed Buff creates a bounded Level-long economy effect without occupying a held Buff slot.
items.icon: Three ivory seed dots dropping into three adjacent square cells; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing runItemState Level stamp and activeBuffSources provenance. Proposed price 6 replaces 4. Do not incorrectly apply new non-Clue eligibility to this unchanged existing coin hook.

items.name: Fresh Ink
items.currentEffect: +2 Mult before Bookmarks for the rest of the Puzzle, including this Turn
items.effect: Add 2 to Puzzle Mult before Bookmark multipliers for the remainder of the current Puzzle, including the current Turn. It changes multiplier calculation and does not create placement or clear points by itself.
items.shortEffect: +2 Mult before Bookmarks for the rest of this Puzzle.
items.trigger: Current and later Turn banking in this Puzzle after use.
items.limit: Puzzle-scoped; the existing engine allows repeated copies to add another 2 each time and rejects Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: An enduring additive Puzzle Mult increase, rather than a one-event points boost.
items.icon: One ivory ink drop over two short rising strokes; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing puzzle itemState accumulation and scoring provenance. Proposed price 9 replaces current Rare price 4 because duration is much stronger than a one-event Buff. Retain actual stacking unless separately approved for rework.

items.name: Litmus
items.currentEffect: Select a number to reveal which blank squares it belongs in. Spent when you place a number
items.effect: Choose one digit when using Litmus and reveal all still-blank solution-correct squares for that digit. The chosen digit cannot change, and the reveal ends after the next accepted correct or wrong placement, or at Puzzle end.
items.shortEffect: Choose one digit; reveal its matching blanks until your next placement.
items.trigger: Digit chosen at use; visibility persists until one accepted placement resolves.
items.limit: One locked digit per consumed copy; cannot arm a second active Litmus. Invalid or barred attempts do not spend the reveal, and the overlay never makes barred squares playable.
items.distinctHook: A temporary map of one actual solution digit, distinct from a Clue charge or constraint-only candidates.
items.icon: An ivory narrow test strip with three outlined test squares, one filled; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: New selected-digit persistence is required: the current armed flag allows changing the inspected digit before placement, potentially exposing the whole solution. Proposed rework locks the selection. Retain normal manual-placement scoring rather than silently converting this paid reveal to a Clue; separately expose this policy in the guide. Proposal restricts activation to playing and blocks it under Paywall as solution-backed assistance; both are deliberate changes, not claims about current behavior.

items.name: Paper Crane
items.currentEffect: Choose a number: it scores +50 flat for the rest of the Puzzle
items.effect: Choose one digit and add 50 flat placement points to that digit's scoring placements for the rest of the current Puzzle. Ordinary Clue zeroing still applies; Onyx can restore the placement, including applicable flat bonuses.
items.shortEffect: Choose a digit: +50 flat placement points for it this Puzzle.
items.trigger: Scoring placements of the selected digit after use.
items.limit: Puzzle-scoped digit modifier; repeated existing copies may stack, including on the same digit. Existing engine rejects Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: A chosen-digit flat bonus that persists across placements and Turns.
items.icon: A simple ivory folded-paper crane profile made from five angular strokes; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: Existing paperCraneKey(digit) state and placeSquare flat addition. Proposal reclassifies Common/3 to Uncommon/6 for duration and stacking strength without changing the ability. Preserve clue/Onyx behavior instead of assigning new-item non-Clue rules to an unchanged existing hook.

items.name: Index Request
items.effect: Choose a digit with at least one copy remaining in the Pool and take exactly one copy into your Hand. This neither identifies a correct square nor bypasses any boss restriction on using the drawn card.
items.shortEffect: Choose one available Pool digit and draw one copy.
items.trigger: Immediate chosen-digit draw during playing.
items.limit: One real Pool token per copy; do not consume for an empty Pool or unavailable digit. No Keep Filling activation.
items.distinctHook: Trades Lucky Dip's quantity for deterministic digit selection without revealing a square.
items.icon: An ivory card entering a hand tray beneath a single downward index arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: validated digit selector plus Pool.take. Display available digits only after entering the consumed-choice flow, without showing solution locations. Commit Buff removal and token transfer atomically; counts remain Pool+Hand=remaining blanks.

items.name: Careful Cut
items.effect: Choose one to three tossable cards in your Hand and return them to the Pool without spending Toss allowance. Do not draw replacements; if this empties the Hand, finish the atomic action before running the normal automatic end-of-Turn path once.
items.shortEffect: Return up to 3 selected cards without spending Tosses; no immediate refill.
items.trigger: Immediate committed multi-card selection during playing.
items.limit: At most three cards per copy; requires a legal nonempty selection, respects boss Toss locks, and is unavailable in Keep Filling.
items.distinctHook: Selective Hand thinning preserves good cards but still pays the normal refill-tempo cost.
items.icon: Ivory scissors trimming a three-card fan, with one card remaining beyond the cut; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: separate returnCards action, not repeated Actions.toss calls. Do not spend Tosses or fire paid-Toss reward hooks; adjust blocked-card identities atomically and check conservation after all returns.

items.name: Eraser Shavings
items.effect: Restore up to two Tosses already spent in this Puzzle. Remaining Tosses cannot rise above this Puzzle's originally granted allowance, and no card moves until you later choose to Toss it normally.
items.shortEffect: Restore up to 2 spent Tosses, up to this Puzzle's starting allowance.
items.trigger: Immediate resource restoration during playing.
items.limit: Only previously spent charges can be restored; do not consume at the allowance ceiling or in Keep Filling.
items.distinctHook: Restores future discard flexibility rather than discarding now or changing the Hand immediately.
items.icon: An ivory eraser above two tiny curled shavings; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: explicit grantedTossAllowance and restoredTosses counters. Never decrement lifetime tossedThisPuzzle statistics to implement a refund, since score contracts and analytics may depend on actual Toss history.

items.name: Collation
items.effect: Reveal a seeded sample of up to three tokens from the Pool and arrange the order in which those tokens will be drawn next. They remain part of the Pool until actually drawn; a targeted take of a reserved token removes that token from this short draw schedule.
items.shortEffect: Inspect and reorder the next 3 Pool draws without drawing them now.
items.trigger: Arrange at use; apply to the next one to three normal Pool draws.
items.limit: One pending schedule at a time, at most three tokens, expiring at Puzzle end; no empty-Pool or Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Controls future draw order instead of increasing draw count or exchanging the Hand.
items.icon: Three ivory staggered cards labeled by one, two, and three dots, with an ordering arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: deterministic draw schedule over Pool counts, not a hidden extra inventory. Use the pool RNG once when committing the sample; scheduled draws consume no second random sample. Specific Pool.take removes a matching scheduled reservation first. Save this schedule and RNG state together; preserve conservation and rollback behavior.

items.name: Fair Exchange
items.effect: Return one chosen tossable Hand card and take one different chosen digit that was already in the Pool before the return. Hand count stays unchanged, and no Toss allowance is spent.
items.shortEffect: Swap one held card for a different available Pool digit.
items.trigger: Immediate two-sided exchange during playing.
items.limit: Exactly one card each way; must respect Toss locks and have a different eligible Pool digit. No Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Removes a specific unwanted token while acquiring a specific replacement, without adding Hand size.
items.icon: Two ivory single cards with opposed horizontal arrows between them; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: atomic prevalidated Pool.take plus Pool.put and Hand replacement, with a distinct exchange event rather than Toss rewards. Preserve card lock identity and invalidate one matching Collation reservation if taken.

items.name: Inventory Count
items.effect: Reveal the exact remaining Pool count of each digit for the current Turn, updating after every legal token transfer. Hide the counts again when that Turn ends; no solution positions are revealed.
items.shortEffect: See the remaining Pool counts of digits 1–9 for this Turn.
items.trigger: Information overlay from use until current Turn end.
items.limit: One active overlay; do not consume a duplicate while active. No Keep Filling use and no free pre-consumption count preview.
items.distinctHook: A temporary inventory ledger for informed draw and Toss decisions, not a correct-square hint.
items.icon: An ivory abacus-like row of three short tally columns inside a ledger outline; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: scoped Pool-count visibility. Pool.swift intentionally keeps these counts hidden today, so this is an explicit new information ability; counts are also theoretically deducible from board and Hand. Do not query Board.solution to implement the overlay.

items.name: Proof Sheet
items.effect: Choose one row, column, or box and show the digits allowed by the visible Sudoku constraints in each of its blank squares until the current Turn ends. Candidates update as numbers are placed, but they are possibilities, not promises of the stored solution.
items.shortEffect: Show visible-rule candidates in one row, column, or box for this Turn.
items.trigger: Unit selected at use; live constraint-only annotation for the current Turn.
items.limit: One annotated unit at a time, no duplicate activation or Keep Filling use; does not reveal fogged values or lift barred squares.
items.distinctHook: Unit-wide deduction aid computed from visible peers, with no solution access.
items.icon: An ivory three-by-three mini grid with three small candidate dots inside its center cell; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: candidate calculation over visible fixed values only. Hidden/fogged contents cannot secretly eliminate candidates. Keep candidate overlays inside an optional inspection view to avoid permanent board clutter and label them as candidates.

items.name: Fold Test
items.effect: Choose one blank square and learn whether its solution digit is odd or even. Keep that parity note until the square is filled or the Puzzle ends; it gives partial solution information without naming a digit or automatically placing one.
items.shortEffect: Learn whether one blank square needs an odd or even digit.
items.trigger: Square selected at use; one persistent parity note for that blank.
items.limit: One note per consumed copy; do not consume on a filled, given, already parity-revealed, or currently barred square. Paywall and Buffborger block use; no Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Partial solution information that narrows possibilities rather than identifying a complete placement.
items.icon: An ivory folded square split into a three-dot half and a two-dot half; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: explicitly solution-backed partial reveal with persisted parity annotation. This paid information is not a Clue placement and does not mark the eventual placement as Clue; that proposed policy must be stated openly. Repeated uses on different cells cost separate consumed copies.

items.name: Rebind
items.effect: Move one claimed coordinate of an owned Marker from an untriggered blank square to a different blank, unmarked square; all other coordinates owned by that Marker stay in place. The move persists for later Puzzles in this Book, preserving Marker-type counters and moving the selected claim record, including its history and spent state, without any reset.
items.shortEffect: Move one untriggered Marker claim from a blank to a different blank, unmarked square.
items.trigger: Choose one claimed source coordinate and a legal destination, then commit during playing.
items.limit: One claimed coordinate moved per copy; source and destination must both be blank and unbarred, and that source claim must not have triggered this Puzzle. No Keep Filling use; the Marker’s other claimed squares are unchanged.
items.distinctHook: Repositions one claimed square of an existing Marker type without buying, duplicating, resetting, or moving its other claims.
items.icon: An ivory marked square connected by a curved binding arrow to an empty square; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: claim-record relocation with per-coordinate, per-Puzzle activation provenance. Replace exactly one coordinate in the owning Marker’s squares, preserving its type-level counters, entitlement, and purchase provenance. Move all claim-specific history, including Patina history and spent flags, with that claim record; never reset it because the coordinate changed. Given or filled source squares are ineligible. Commit the move atomically.

items.name: Transposition
items.effect: Swap exactly one claimed coordinate from each of two different owned Marker types, with both selected claims on blank squares and neither having triggered this Puzzle; each type’s other claims stay in place. Preserve both types’ counters and move each selected claim record, including its history and spent state, to its exchanged coordinate without resetting it.
items.shortEffect: Swap two untriggered blank-square claims from different Marker types.
items.trigger: Select one claimed blank coordinate from each of two different owned Marker types during playing.
items.limit: One two-claim swap per copy; selected squares must be distinct, blank, and unbarred, and neither source claim may have triggered this Puzzle. No Keep Filling use or counter reset; all unselected claims remain unchanged.
items.distinctHook: Exchanges the effects assigned to two already-marked squares without moving whole Marker types or needing an empty destination.
items.icon: Two ivory marked cells with crossing curved arrows above and below them; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: atomic pair-claim swap with per-coordinate, per-Puzzle activation guards. Exchange exactly one coordinate in each owning Marker’s squares; keep type-level counters with their types, and carry each selected claim’s full history, including Patina and spent flags, to its new coordinate. Do not remove and repurchase a Marker, reset entitlement, trigger sale/purchase rewards, or alter other claims. Reject selecting the same Marker type twice because that would make no effective exchange.

items.name: Passage
items.effect: Choose one blank square currently barred by a boss and permit one accepted placement there during this Turn. The exception ends after a correct or wrong accepted placement, or at Turn end, and all number restrictions, coin fees, penalties, and scoring rules still apply.
items.shortEffect: Permit one placement on a chosen boss-barred blank this Turn.
items.trigger: Choose a currently barred blank; the next accepted placement on it consumes the permission.
items.limit: One square and one accepted attempt; requires a current boss square bar. Buffborger still prevents activation; no Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: A narrow positional access exception rather than extra score or general boss cancellation.
items.icon: An ivory square gate with one short opening and an arrow passing through; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: per-square one-attempt override in placement validation. Does not alter the boss's original barredSquares set, the next Turn's random selection, or Hand-card blocks. Invalid hand indices and other rejected actions do not consume the permission.

items.name: Release Note
items.effect: Choose one currently blocked card in your Hand and permit one placement or Toss of that exact card during this Turn. The exception bypasses its Hand/digit block only; a barred square, Toss cost, placement fee, and ordinary correctness rules still apply.
items.shortEffect: Free one blocked Hand card for one placement or Toss this Turn.
items.trigger: One blocked token selected; its next accepted placement or Toss consumes the exception.
items.limit: One exact token until used or Turn end, with no spillover to other copies of its digit. No Keep Filling use; Buffborger blocks activation.
items.distinctHook: Card-specific mobility instead of opening a board square.
items.icon: An ivory card with a tiny open padlock hanging from one corner; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: stable Hand-token identity or equivalent safe index remapping. Existing Hand is a Digit array, so the permission must never jump to another card when indices shift. Resolve boss square bars independently.

items.name: Single Issue
items.effect: In an open Shop, replace one chosen unsold offer with a different seeded item of the same category and rarity, at that rarity's normal proposed price. Keep the other stock and the Shop's regular Reroll counter unchanged.
items.shortEffect: Reroll one unsold Shop offer, keeping its category and rarity.
items.trigger: Explicit use in an open Shop on one unsold slot.
items.limit: One replacement per copy; exclude the old definition, owned Bookmarks, and same-stock duplicate Bookmarks/Markers. Do not consume if no alternative exists.
items.distinctHook: Selective stock replacement preserves other desirable merchandise.
items.icon: One ivory price-tag outline encircled by a small refresh arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW SHOP-USE HOOK: Actions.useBuff currently accepts only playing/Keep Filling, so this requires a separate validated Shop Buff action. Use the Shop RNG and current visit provenance; selecting does not buy the new item.

items.name: Reservation
items.effect: As you leave an open Shop, reserve one unsold offer at its current price for the next Shop you reach. It replaces one normal slot of the same category there and remains through that visit's Rerolls until purchased or until you leave that next Shop.
items.shortEffect: Carry one unbought offer and its price into the next Shop.
items.trigger: Choose an unsold offer, then consume only when leaving the current Shop is committed.
items.limit: One pending reservation for the Book; expires after the next reached Shop visit or Book end. No reserved inventory item or coins are granted.
items.distinctHook: Preserves a desired future purchase across a puzzle and payout instead of discounting it now.
items.icon: An ivory price tag tucked behind a small calendar corner; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW SHOP/ROUTE HOOK: persisted reserved offer with defID, price, category, source visit, and destination visit. Cannot consume a duplicate reservation. Apply ownership exclusions before the next stock is displayed and keep a single physical stock slot rather than duplicating the offer. If no later Shop is reachable, reject use.

items.name: Counteroffer
items.effect: Reduce one chosen unsold Marker's price in the current Shop by 4 coins, to a minimum price of 1. The reduction belongs to that offer until it is bought or rerolled; it does not grant coins or apply to Buff purchases.
items.shortEffect: Reduce one Marker offer by 4 coins, to a minimum price of 1.
items.trigger: Explicit Shop use on a current unsold Marker offer.
items.limit: At most one Counteroffer per Shop visit and no stacking on an offer; do not consume if the price cannot fall. Expires with that stock or Shop.
items.distinctHook: A committed Marker-specific bargain, separate from coin income and general Reroll discounts.
items.icon: An ivory outlined price tag crossed by a small downward negotiation arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW SHOP-USE HOOK: store the actual discounted purchase price as pricePaid so resale never uses the undiscounted price. Cap to one use per visit to avoid repeat discount loops. Buying this at 3 can save at most 4, a bounded one-coin net benefit.

items.name: Supplement
items.effect: Choose Bookmarks, Markers, or Buffs; add one extra offer of that category to the initial stock of the next Shop you reach. It must still be purchased at its normal price and disappears on that visit's first Reroll or when you leave.
items.shortEffect: Add one extra offer of a chosen category to the next Shop's opening stock.
items.trigger: Choose category during playing or a nonterminal briefing; realize the order on the next Shop open.
items.limit: One pending Supplement; one extra offer only, with no guarantee of rarity or availability if its catalog is exhausted. No Keep Filling activation.
items.distinctHook: Expands future choice by one item without granting an item, discount, or extra inventory slot.
items.icon: An ivory extra page sliding beside a three-page stack; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW ROUTE/SHOP HOOK: category-tagged pending extra stock slot, seeded from Shop RNG, saved once. Keep the normal 2/2/1 composition intact and apply all owned/stock exclusions; this temporary sixth offer requires explicit Shop layout support. Never recursively generate another Buff reward.

items.name: Free Press
items.effect: Apply up to 6 coins of credit to the next paid regular Reroll in the current Shop. Charge any cost above 6 normally, then advance the Reroll counter exactly as if its full price had been paid.
items.shortEffect: Cover up to 6 coins of your next paid Reroll in this Shop.
items.trigger: Arm in an open Shop; consume the credit on the next regular Reroll with a positive cost.
items.limit: One armed credit per visit; expires when leaving. Free Rerolls do not spend it; unused credit never becomes coins, and it cannot stack with another copy.
items.distinctHook: Pays a bounded part of the regular full-stock refresh while preserving normal escalating prices.
items.icon: An ivory full-circle refresh arrow around a small ticket notch, unlike Single Issue's single price tag; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW SHOP-USE HOOK: apply a noncash discount to Shop.reroll payment only. Store regular underlying cost and increment rerollsUsed normally; do not reset escalation or refund unused credit. This cannot create money or perpetually fund itself.

items.name: Detour
items.effect: Before starting a non-boss Puzzle, inspect its normal given layout and one seeded alternative with the same slot, difficulty, target, and resource rules, then choose which layout to play. Your Marker coordinates stay fixed, and only givens—not solutions—are previewed.
items.shortEffect: Before a non-boss Puzzle, choose between two equally difficult given layouts.
items.trigger: Briefing-only action before the next non-boss board is committed.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle slot, with exactly one alternative; consume when the two-layout choice is revealed, including if you keep the original. No boss reroll, skip reward, or extra Shop is created.
items.distinctHook: Route-level board-layout choice to suit a positional Marker build.
items.icon: Two ivory small grid outlines on a forked path, one arrow selecting the alternate; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW BRIEFING/GENERATOR HOOK: deterministic alternate-board domain seed and persisted choice, with equivalent generator constraints and uniqueness checks. Never reroll the Level's boss, payout, shop stock, or skip reward as a side effect. Current Actions.useBuff cannot run here.

items.name: Boss Draft
items.effect: Before entering the current Level's boss Puzzle, reveal one different seeded eligible boss and choose between it and the already announced boss. The board generation, target, and rewards remain those of the same boss slot; the chosen boss's own normal resource modifiers still apply.
items.shortEffect: Before the boss Puzzle, choose the announced boss or one seeded alternative.
items.trigger: Level briefing only, before its boss encounter is started.
items.limit: One two-boss choice per Level; consumed on reveal even if you keep the original. It cannot change an active boss or skip the encounter.
items.distinctHook: A strategic matchup choice for the existing build, not temporary suppression during combat.
items.icon: An ivory boss-page silhouette with two alternative tabs and one small selection check; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW ROUTE HOOK: alternate draw excludes the announced boss and uses a dedicated deterministic domain. Persist chosen pendingBoss, preserve boss-board seed and slot identity, and recompute legitimate selected-boss modifiers only on puzzle creation. No use during Buffborger; briefing use happens before an encounter exists.

items.name: Tight Deadline
items.effect: Permanently remove one future Turn from the current Puzzle's allowance to add 3 Mult before Bookmarks to the eligible non-Clue portion of this Turn's bank. Clue-derived points and zeroed events receive no bonus; the modifier expires after this bank even if it cannot apply.
items.shortEffect: Trade 1 future Turn for +3 Mult before Bookmarks this Turn.
items.trigger: Use during playing; shorten the allowance immediately and apply the multiplier at the current Turn bank.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; requires at least one future Turn beyond the current Turn to sacrifice. No Keep Filling or out-of-Turns use.
items.distinctHook: A tempo-for-score trade that makes the remaining solve harder instead of granting free duration.
items.icon: An ivory clock edge clipped by a small scissor blade beside three short rising strokes; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: explicit turnsMax reduction plus current-turn eligible-point partition and additive Mult provenance. Do not decrement turnNumber, trigger boss selection, or refill Hand. A simple global pendingMult addition is insufficient when the queue mixes eligible events with Onyx-restored Clue points: only the non-Clue portion receives this extra +3 stage.

items.name: Collateral
items.effect: Before any scoring event in a Turn, suspend one currently active owned Bookmark for the rest of this Puzzle to increase the normal Hand-size refill target by 2. The Bookmark stays owned in its slot and returns at Puzzle end; already queued rewards and its stored growth are not erased.
items.shortEffect: Suspend one Bookmark this Puzzle to gain +2 Hand-size capacity on future refills.
items.trigger: Choose an active Bookmark at a clean Turn start during playing.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; requires an owned active Bookmark and cannot target a boss-disabled one. No immediate draw, Keep Filling use, sale, or replacement of the pledged instance while suspended.
items.distinctHook: Trades one passive engine component for sustained Hand flexibility without adding another inventory slot.
items.icon: An ivory bookmark held by a small clasp beside two extra card corners; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: source-specific temporary suspension, persistent suspended UUID, and +2 refill-target modifier. Activate before turn scoring order locks; suppress both passive and event hooks of that source without resetting its counters. Restore ownership functionality on win/failure or save recovery.

items.name: Exchange Rate
items.effect: Pay one to three coins when using this Buff to gain the same amount of additional Mult before Bookmarks on the eligible non-Clue portion of the current Turn's bank. Clue-derived points and zeroed events receive no bonus, and this modifier creates no points on its own.
items.shortEffect: Pay up to 3 coins for the same amount of extra Mult this Turn.
items.trigger: Choose and pay the coin amount during playing; resolve at the current Turn bank.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle, maximum 3 coins and +3 Mult; no debt, refund, Keep Filling use, or zero-payment consumption.
items.distinctHook: Converts spendable economy into a one-Turn score push, at an explicit additional resource cost.
items.icon: One ivory coin outline transforming through a short arrow into multiplier spokes; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: atomic coin payment plus current-turn eligible-point partition. The Buff's shop price is separate from the chosen payment. Do not fire coin-gain hooks, refund coins when the queue is zeroed, or let a global multiplier amplify Onyx-restored Clue points; only eligible non-Clue points receive the extra additive Mult stage.

items.name: Return Receipt
items.effect: Cancel one still-unspent Insurance, Double Down, or Second Print charge that came from a Buff you consumed in this Puzzle, and return that exact original Buff instance to your inventory. This does not rewind any action or recover an effect that has already triggered.
items.shortEffect: Recover one unused armed Insurance, Double Down, or Second Print Buff.
items.trigger: Select an eligible owned-provenance armed charge during playing.
items.limit: One original instance per use; consuming Return Receipt frees its own inventory slot for the recovered item. No Keep Filling use, anonymous flags, partial recoveries, or copies of this Buff.
items.distinctHook: Reclaims a committed but unused consumable rather than generating a new random reward.
items.icon: An ivory receipt with one return arrow pointing back to a small token outline; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: archive spent OwnedBuff instances rather than only UUID strings, with exactly-once recovery status. Preserve original UUID, pricePaid, and shop provenance; clear flag and provenance atomically. Cannot duplicate a source or undo prior payouts.

items.name: Clean Finish
items.effect: Commit your current Hand of at least three cards: if every one of those exact cards is correctly placed for positive non-Clue placement points before this Turn ends, add 150 flat points when the last tracked card resolves. Any wrong placement, Toss, exchange, return, or Clue placement of a tracked card fails the challenge.
items.shortEffect: Place your entire current Hand cleanly this Turn to earn +150 flat points.
items.trigger: Record the current Hand at use; reward on the final qualifying tracked-card placement.
items.limit: One active challenge and one reward per Puzzle; at least three tracked cards, no Keep Filling use. Newly drawn cards are not tracked and do not increase the reward.
items.distinctHook: An exact-Hand completion contract, not merely a reward for playing a last card or having an empty Hand.
items.icon: Three ivory card outlines funneling into a single clean checkmark; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: stable card identities, challenge membership, and action invalidation. Award before the normal empty-Hand auto-end path so the existing bank includes it. Boss-zeroed or Clue-scored tracked cards fail rather than secretly satisfying the challenge.

items.name: Cross-Cut
items.effect: Arm a reward for one non-Clue placement that completes at least two eligible scoring units at once; add 120 flat points for two units, or 180 for three. All counted row, column, or box clears must have positive nonzeroed points, and the placement itself must also be eligible.
items.shortEffect: Your next eligible double or triple Line Clear adds +120 or +180 flat points.
items.trigger: Next eligible simultaneous multi-unit completion after use.
items.limit: One reward until Puzzle end; ordinary single clears leave it armed. No duplicate arming or Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: Pays for simultaneous spatial intersections, unlike Second Print's next single-unit doubling.
items.icon: One ivory row and column crossing at a small filled square, with a box outline behind; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: post-resolution completed-unit receipts, counted once per placement. The flat reward is queued once after confirming actual scoring eligibility, before auto-end; it does not fire fake Line Clear hooks or pay per repeated callback.

items.name: Open Bracket
items.effect: Choose two distinct unbarred blank squares in different boxes; if both receive eligible positive-point non-Clue placements before this Puzzle ends, add 200 flat points to the second completion. The contract fails if either chosen square is filled by a Clue or a zeroed placement.
items.shortEffect: Choose two blanks in different boxes; fill both normally for +200 flat points.
items.trigger: Two squares selected at use; reward on the second eligible completed target.
items.limit: One active contract and one reward per Puzzle; no Keep Filling use. Wrong attempts do not complete targets and retain their ordinary penalties.
items.distinctHook: The player authors a two-position solving objective instead of receiving a fixed digit or line condition.
items.icon: Two ivory opposite brackets enclosing two small separated cell dots; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: persisted target-square pair with completion/failure bits. Do not reveal either target's solution or add permanent Marker objects; use a quiet temporary inspection cue compatible with hold-to-inspect. Pay once on the second eligible receipt.

items.name: New Edition
items.effect: In an open Shop, replace one chosen owned Bookmark with a seeded different unowned Bookmark of the same rarity. The new Bookmark occupies the same inventory position with fresh counters; no coin refund, sale reward, purchase reward, or higher-rarity guarantee is granted.
items.shortEffect: Exchange one owned Bookmark for a different random one of the same rarity.
items.trigger: Choose the owned Bookmark and commit before the replacement identity is revealed.
items.limit: One replacement per copy; requires an eligible alternative and an unpledged Bookmark. Does not operate during a Puzzle or recover the old item's growth.
items.distinctHook: Rebuilds an existing passive slot without gaining an item slot or selling for currency.
items.icon: An ivory bookmark silhouette changing to a second differently-notched bookmark through a short arrow; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW SHOP-USE/INVENTORY HOOK: seeded definition transformation, new stable instance identity, pricePaid=0, no purchase provenance, and reset definition-specific counters. Retire the old instance fully, invalidate same-definition unsold offers according to the normal owned-Bookmark rule, and do not fire buy/sell hooks.

items.name: Carbon Receipt
items.effect: Repeat the immediate effect of the most recently used eligible Buff in this Puzzle: Peek, Redraw, Double Down, Insurance, Second Print, or Lucky Dip. Show which effect will repeat before confirming; the repeated effect must pass its normal guards and uses fresh seeded draws where applicable.
items.shortEffect: Repeat your last eligible basic Buff effect, without creating another Buff item.
items.trigger: Use during playing after one whitelisted Buff was successfully consumed in this Puzzle.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle; cannot copy itself, another new Buff, Fresh Ink, Paper Crane, Bird Seed, Overtime, or Litmus. Cannot consume when the copied effect would be blocked, redundant, or empty; no Keep Filling use.
items.distinctHook: A flexible repeat of a previously chosen basic tool, not random inventory generation.
items.icon: Two ivory receipt outlines aligned over a dark carbon layer, one small echo arc; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: explicit eligible-use history separate from generated effects. Carbon Receipt never becomes a new copy target and never recreates an OwnedBuff; whitelist excludes currency, permanent growth, route actions, and recursive copies. Repeated arming records Carbon Receipt as the source, making it ineligible for Return Receipt recovery of a nonexistent original basic Buff.

items.name: Rain Check
items.effect: Choose 20 to 100 of this Turn's queued eligible placement points and remove them from the current bank; on your first eligible positive-point non-Clue placement next Turn, add twice that amount as flat queued points. If no such placement happens during that next Turn, or the Puzzle ends first, the deferred bonus is lost.
items.shortEffect: Defer 20–100 queued placement points to double them on an eligible placement next Turn.
items.trigger: Commit the point amount during playing, then resolve on the first eligible placement of the immediately following Turn.
items.limit: Once per Puzzle, maximum 100 deferred and 200 returned; requires a future playable Turn and enough eligible original placement points. No Keep Filling, Line Clear points, other Buff bonus points, or Clue-derived points may fund it.
items.distinctHook: A delayed score investment with an actual present cost and a one-Turn failure window.
items.icon: An ivory ticket with a clock-shaped perforation and an arrow into a second page; charcoal and gold family.
items.implementationNotes: NEW HOOK: provenance-aware queued-point debit and deferred credit. Debited points cannot be spent twice, copied, or counted as having banked this Turn; the return is a Buff bonus and cannot fund another Rain Check. Preserve the loss on early win/skip/failure and never create a synthetic placement or clear event.
